{"metadata":{"description":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that automatically sends the x-opencode-session request header on model calls routed to OpenCode / OpenCode Go providers — one stable session id per DSH conversation.","id":"gh:1365572890","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-opencode-session","slug":"nobu121/dsh-opencode-session","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that automatically sends the x-opencode-session request header on mo"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"del calls routed to OpenCode / OpenCode Go providers — one stable session id per DSH conversation."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-opencode-session"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
plugin that automatically sends the **`x-opencode-session`** request header"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" on
model calls routed to **OpenCode / OpenCode Go** providers — one stable
session id per DSH conve"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"l calls routed to **OpenCode / OpenCode Go** providers — one stable
session id per DSH conversation."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Since 2026-09-05 OpenCode's relay requires an `x-opencode-session` header on
API requests (tracked u"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"pstream in
deepseek-harness discussion #5495);
without it, requests fail with `400 MissingSessionID`"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"-style errors. Requests
that share the same header value are pinned to the same upstream backend,
wh"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ich is also what keeps OpenCode's prompt cache warm across the turns of one
conversation."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"This plugin:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **fixes the 400** by always attaching the header to OpenCode(Go) requests,
- **keeps the cache/aff"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"inity benefit** by using a value that is unique **per
conversation** and stable across that conversa"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"tion's turns (by default the
DSH session id itself, the same identity the official DeepSeek adapter
"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"already sends as `x-deepseek-harness-session-id`),
- leaves every other provider, and every request "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"that already carries the
header, untouched."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"From the npm registry (once published):"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"From a local checkout:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Then **fully restart** your dsh profile (bundle layers are read at startup).
The startup log shows:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"If you run DSH from a source checkout instead, load it as an overlay:
`pnpm dsh web --patch ./cordis"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"SH from a source checkout instead, load it as an overlay:
`pnpm dsh web --patch ./cordis.patch.yml`."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The plugin row lives in the bundle's `cordis.patch.yml`; all keys are optional:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- `providers` — provider route keys whose requests get the header. The
defaults cover the pi-ai cata"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"log ids `opencode` and `opencode-go`; add your
own route key when you serve OpenCode through a custo"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"m provider name.
- `mode`
- `session-id` (default) — header value = the DSH session id of the model
"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"call. Unique per conversation, stable across turns, compaction, retries
and process restarts.
- `uui"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"d` — a random UUID derived once per DSH session id (opaque; kept in
memory, so it resets when the pr"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"ocess restarts).
- `debug` — log every streamed call that receives the header via
`ctx.logger` (the "},{"id":"p19s7","text":"dsh process console).
- `debugFile` — optional absolute path. When set, every streamed call that
rec"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"eives the header appends one JSON line
(`{"ts","provider","model","session","header","value"}`) to t"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"hat file —
handy when the dsh console is not visible."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"To override configuration in a profile without editing the package, add a
row with the same id in th"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"e profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (it replaces the
whole `config`, so restate every key)."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"1. Listens on the `llm/stream` waterfall. A call whose `options.provider`
names a configured OpenCod"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"e route and which carries a `sessionId` is
driven through an `AsyncLocalStorage` store holding the h"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"eader value.
2. `globalThis.fetch` is patched once. While such a store is active, the
outgoing reque"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"st receives `x-opencode-session: <value>` (unless it already
carries the header — an existing value "},{"id":"p22s5","text":"always wins).
3. Both registrations are fiber-scoped ctx effects: stopping / updating /
unloading th"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"e plugin restores the original `fetch` and removes the
listener."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Non-OpenCode providers, requests without a `sessionId` (some auxiliary
hand-built calls), and model "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"discovery requests pass through untouched."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Notes / limitations"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- The header is attached to chat/streaming requests inside an `llm/stream`
call. The one-shot model "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"listing used by the Models page
(`GET <baseURL>/models`) is a separate flow and does not receive the"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"
header; if your OpenCode endpoint also rejects that listing, open an issue.
- The plugin relies on "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"DSH outbound LLM requests going through the Node
global `fetch`. If a future DSH version swaps its n"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"etwork stack, the
plugin stops injecting (symptom: the 400 comes back) — uninstall then."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Publishing (for maintainers)"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The package is plain ESM JavaScript with zero dependencies; `npm test` runs
automatically via `prepu"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" is plain ESM JavaScript with zero dependencies; `npm test` runs
automatically via `prepublishOnly`."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Before publishing, double-check the name is free on the npm registry and fill
in `author`, `homepage"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"`, and `repository` in `package.json` if you like."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
